newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber extends gains on European buying.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber extends gains on European buying.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices extended earlier gains in late trading on Wednesday following some European buying, traders said.
They said March SIR20 was 0.25 U.S. cents higher at 53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, Palembang and Surabaya. Offer prices were quoted at 53.25 U.S. cents, also up 0.25 cents fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There were no fresh deals taking place today. Dealers are taking a wait-and-see position because they wish to see prices to pick up," said one trader.
Dealers said market sentiment had weakened recently because of sustained thin U.S. demand.
